events.title: Fossil Day 2026
events.description: Calling all dinosaur lovers, future paleontologists, and curious kids. Fossil Day at Science Museum Oklahoma is a hands-on celebration with activities the whole family can explore together. Guests can sift for fossils, prepare real specimens using paleontology tools, compare dinosaur teeth, touch real fossils and 3D prints, meet Oklahoma’s state dinosaur and state fossil, and explore how birds are connected to dinosaurs. Plus, enjoy a special dinosaur planetarium show offered throughout the day…
